items.title: Sensex falls over 20% in dollar terms in 2026 as weak sentiment, rupee drag returns
items.description: The benchmark Sensex and Nifty have both experienced significant declines in dollar terms this year. Foreign investors have been less interested in Indian equities due to various global factors. The rupee's depreciation has further amplified losses for overseas investors converting Indian investments. Despite the downturn, strong domestic mutual fund inflows have offset foreign portfolio outflows effectively. India's stock market faces challenges in maintaining investor sentiment amidst changing market dynamics.

items.title: KPIT Tech plunges 24% in 3 months as auto demand weakens
items.description: KPIT Technologies faces a substantial 24% decline in stock value, predominantly due to obstacles in the automotive sector. The company's net profit has notably decreased, attributed to project delays and financial cutbacks. Although management forecasts a rebound in the latter half of the year, the September quarter might reflect ongoing weaknesses.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Nifty fell significantly, closing at 22,716 after hitting a six-month low during the trading session. Foreign investors continued selling shares, contributing to market volatility, while domestic institutions showed buying interest. The rupee settled marginally higher due to RBI interventions and falling oil prices. Immediate support levels are identified around 22550-22500, with resistance expected at 22800-22900. Market sentiment remains cautious amid ongoing global economic concerns and local selling pressure.

items.title: Stocks in news: Tata Steel, KPI Green Energy, NLC India, Poonawalla Fincorp and Cummins India
items.description: Indian equity benchmarks faced a decline as both the Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex hit six-month lows. The Nifty 50 saw a drop of 64.05 points, or 0.28%, closing at 22,716.20. Notably, Tata Steel announced a favorable tax order and made significant investments in its subsidiary. Other companies including Poonawalla Fincorp and Cummins India reported various corporate developments affecting their market positions.

items.title: These 8 banking stocks have an upside potential of up to 26%  in 1 year, according to analysts
items.description: Given the current market situation, no sector is immune from headwinds. The banking sector is no exception. There are clear short-term headwinds, but the question an investor should ask is: Are these headwinds likely to hit the core business of banks and create some issue that may take a long time to settle?

items.title: 202 BSE 500 stocks trade below five-year average valuations
items.description: An analysis indicates that more than 50% of companies within the BSE 500 are trading below their five-year average valuations. Furthermore, close to two-thirds of these organizations have not provided any returns in the past two years. Geopolitical tensions have resulted in marked volatility in energy prices, impacting logistics and commodity costs on a global scale.

items.title: Jobs in line as IRDAI commission caps force insurance brokers to rethink models
items.description: Facing new commission regulations from the IRDAI, insurance brokers, including Quickinsure, are tweaking their business approaches. This pivot might cause a staggering loss of over 100,000 jobs as the industry reduces reliance on fixed sales teams. Brokers are expected to embrace more flexible cost structures and optimize sales output. Unfortunately, smaller brokers lack the established client base needed to weather these changes, risking their operational sustainability.

items.title: Panel proposes raising RBI's ways and means advances corpus by 11.2% to Rs 67,839 crore
items.description: The panel has also recommended an annual review of the WMA corpus capping annual upward revision at 4%. The extent of upward revision could be based on the last three years of accounts while there would be no reduction in the existing limit.

items.title: TCS, Wipro, other IT stocks rebound up to 6%, snapping 8-day losing streak. Why is Jefferies cautious?
items.description: IT stocks rebounded on Wednesday, with TCS, Wipro and Coforge snapping an eight-session losing streak. The Nifty IT index rose nearly 3%, aided by a stronger US dollar and higher US bond yields, though brokerages remain cautious ahead of the Q2 earnings season.

items.title: Festive crash ahead? Nifty bulls face 4 bearish signs as October F&O series begins
items.description: Nifty enters the October series after a 6.7% fall in the September series, its worst in 25 years. Foreign investors sold Rs 25,662 crore of Indian equities, while bearish futures positions increased. The index is also testing its 200-week moving average, making 22,600 a key technical level for investors.

items.title: Cupid, Sterlite Tech among 10 smallcap stocks set for sharp fund flows after Nifty rejig. See full list
items.description: The National Stock Exchange’s (NSE) semi-annual rejig of Nifty indices takes effect from September 30, with Nuvama Alternative & Quantitative Research highlighting the stocks likely to see the highest inflows and outflows as a result. Here are 10 small-cap stocks that could see the sharpest inflows and outflows.

items.title: STL Networks shares jump 5% after emerging as L1 bidder for RailTel contract worth Rs 250 crore
items.description: STL Networks shares rose 5% after emerging as the lowest bidder for a Rs 249.8 crore RailTel contract to deploy cloud infrastructure at data centre and disaster recovery sites. The company is also planning a wholly owned subsidiary focused on data centres and connectivity. Its stock has gained sharply in recent months.

items.title: Avalon Tech shares fall 6% after Rs 883 crore block deal; 3 promoter entities likely sellers
items.description: Avalon Technologies shares sharply on Wednesday after an Rs 883 crore block deal involving 6.06% of the company’s equity. Three promoter entities were reported to be the likely sellers. The transaction is estimated to be worth between Rs 861.9 crore and Rs 922 crore.

items.title: KSB shares rally 7% after securing Rs 118 crore export order for boiler feed pumps
items.description: KSB shares gained 7% after the company secured a $12.4-million export order from Dangote Projects Free Zone Enterprise for 18 boiler feed pump packages.

items.title: Molbio Diagnostics shares rally 9% as Jefferies initiates 'high conviction top pick' call for recently listed stock. Why is it bullish?
items.description: Molbio Diagnostics shares jumped after Jefferies initiated coverage with a Buy rating and named it a high-conviction top pick. The brokerage set a Rs 1,600 target price, implying 27% upside from Tuesday’s close and nearly 98% above its Rs 807 IPO price. The stock had listed at a 21% premium at Rs 980.

items.title: Power Mech Projects shares rise 4% after company secures Rs 549 crore order from Adani Group firm
items.description: Power Mech Projects shares gained after securing a Rs 549.37-crore O&M order from Moxie Power Generation for its 2x600 MW Tuticorin thermal power plant, with the contract spanning five years.

items.title: Sensex rises 130 points, Nifty falls below 22,700 amid cooling oil, rising bond yields. What lies ahead?
items.description: Indian shares traded mixed as easing oil prices supported sentiment, while surging US bond yields kept investors cautious. Sensex gained around 130 points, while Nifty slipped below 22,700 amid weak global cues.

items.title: Cupid shares rally 16% in two sessions. What’s behind the sharp uptick in the multibagger stock?
items.description: Cupid shares surged 7% after entering the Nifty Smallcap 250 index, extending gains to 16% in two sessions. The company has raised FY27 revenue and profit guidance following strong quarterly growth. Nuvama estimates around $10 million in potential inflows, while Cupid targets continued expansion across healthcare exports and consumer businesses.

items.title: Nifty nears longest losing streak in 25 years. Can bulls stop the 8th consecutive weekly selloff?
items.description: Indian equities face continued pressure from global uncertainty, crude prices and foreign investor outflows, but analysts see domestic resilience and moderating valuations providing support. The Nifty has become relatively cheaper after its recent correction, with earnings still growing. However, the near-term outlook hinges on the index holding 22,600 and attracting sustained buying to prevent an eighth consecutive weekly decline.

items.title: LTM among 3 stocks that closed below VWAP
items.description: On September 29, the closing prices of three Nifty 500 stocks were more than 2.5% below their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Prices), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.VWAP represents the average price at which a stock traded during the day, weighted by trading volume. A closing price below VWAP indicates the stock ended the session below its volume-weighted average traded price.

items.title: 5 SME IPOs to list today: Liqvd Digital, Unitec Fibres among most subscribed issues
items.description: On September 30, investors will witness the debut of five small and medium-sized enterprise IPOs, including Coreintegra Consulting and Pooja Logistics. Among these, Liqvd Digital stands out with an impressive subscription rate of 5.08 times. Coreintegra and Pooja also performed well, with subscriptions of 1.40 times and 3.11 times, respectively, while S.K. Offset and Unitec Fibres showed lower but notable interest.

items.title: Foreign outflows from Indian stocks hit 6-month high in September on higher oil, yields
items.description: Foreign portfolio investors saw a notable outflow of $2.7 billion from Indian equities in September, marking the most significant withdrawal in the past six months. This trend has been driven by escalating oil prices and a tightening of global monetary policies. The rise in crude prices is straining India's current account and inflation expectations, which is weighing heavily on the rupee.

items.title: Vishal Mega Mart among 3 stocks that closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: On September 29, the closing prices of three stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 3% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.When the closing price is above the VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Morgan Stanley raises Lenskart target price to Rs 718; bull case implies 41% upside. Here’s why
items.description: Lenskart Solutions reported a 182.3% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 228 crore, while revenue grew 33.6% to Rs 2,214 crore. EBITDA margin improved to 21.7%, with growth across domestic and international markets. The company also reported strong demand for both affordable and premium eyewear, highlighting the scaling potential of its international business.
